title: Baked Fish with Orange-Ginger Gel
description: Baked Fish with Orange-Ginger Gel is a contemporary continental seafood dish featuring perfectly baked fish complemented by a vibrant citrus-ginger gel and an optional silky beurre blanc. Finished with seasonal vegetables and elegant garnishes, this fine-dining recipe delivers delicate flavors with refined restaurant-style presentation.

ingredients.title: For the Fish
items: 4 fillets of sea bass, halibut, or cod (skin on, ~150g each)

ingredients.title: For the Orange-Ginger Gel
items: 10 g sugar (adjust based on orange sweetness)

ingredients.title: For the Beurre Blanc (Optional Sauce Base)
Garnishes & Accompaniments
items: Blanched baby carrots, asparagus tips, or baby courgettes
Micro herbs (coriander, basil, or pea shoots)

instruction.title: Step 1 – Prepare the Orange-Ginger Gel
steps: In a small saucepan, combine orange juice, ginger slices, and sugar.
Simmer gently for 8–10 minutes to infuse, then strain.
Stir in lemon juice and agar-agar. Bring back to a boil for 1–2 minutes.
Pour into a shallow tray and refrigerate until set.
Once firm, blend into a smooth gel. Pass through a fine sieve into a squeeze bottle for plating.

instruction.title: Step 2 – Cook the Fish
steps: Pat fish dry, season with sea salt and white pepper.
Heat olive oil in a non-stick pan. Sear fish skin-side down for 2 minutes until crisp.
Transfer pan to oven and bake for 6–8 minutes (depending on thickness). The fish should be just cooked, moist, and flaky.

instruction.title: Step 3 – Beurre Blanc (Optional)
steps: In a saucepan, reduce wine, vinegar, and shallot until about 2 tbsp remain.
Lower heat and whisk in butter cubes gradually, ensuring sauce stays emulsified.

instruction.title: Step 4 – Vegetables
steps: Blanch baby vegetables in salted water until just tender.
Shock in ice water to preserve color, then reheat gently in butter before serving.

instruction.title: Step 5 – Plating (Fine Dining Style)
steps: Place fish slightly off-center on the plate.
Dot or swipe orange-ginger gel artistically around the fish.
Arrange baby vegetables neatly, adding height and color contrast.
Spoon beurre blanc lightly around (not over) the fish for refinement.
Finish with micro herbs and, if available, a small edible flower for elegance.

servingSuggestions.title: Serving Suggestions
items: Serve immediately with the orange-ginger gel, beurre blanc, and seasonal vegetables for an elegant fine-dining presentation.

chefTips: The balance of the dish comes from the citrus freshness, the subtle heat of ginger, and the richness of the beurre blanc.
Do not overpower the fish—keep flavors delicate and precise.
Blend and strain the gel thoroughly for a perfectly smooth restaurant-quality finish.
Serve on warm plates to maintain the ideal serving temperature.
